mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: NamespaceMapper.selectRdfNamespaceCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_namespace t1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: NamespaceMapper.selectRdfNamespaceList */ t1.rdf_nmsp_id , t1.rdf_nmsp_pfix , t1.rdf_nmsp_uri , t1.rdf_nmsp_aply_mtcd , t2.mtcd_nm AS rdf_nmsp_aply_mtcd_nm , t1.rdf_nmsp_regr_id , t1.rdf_nmsp_regr_nm , to_char(t1.rdf_nmsp_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_nmsp_reg_dt , t1.rdf_nmsp_amdr_id , t1.rdf_nmsp_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.rdf_nmsp_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_nmsp_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_namespace t1 LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code t2 ON t1.rdf_nmsp_aply_mtcd = t2.mtcd AND t2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00026'

SELECT /* SQL_ID: NamespaceMapper.selectRdfNamespace */ t1.rdf_nmsp_id , t1.rdf_nmsp_pfix , t1.rdf_nmsp_uri , t1.rdf_nmsp_aply_mtcd , t2.mtcd_nm AS rdf_nmsp_aply_mtcd_nm , t1.rdf_nmsp_regr_id , t1.rdf_nmsp_regr_nm , to_char(t1.rdf_nmsp_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_nmsp_reg_dt , t1.rdf_nmsp_amdr_id , t1.rdf_nmsp_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.rdf_nmsp_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_nmsp_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_namespace t1 LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code t2 ON t1.rdf_nmsp_aply_mtcd = t2.mtcd AND t2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00026' WHERE t1.rdf_nmsp_id = #{rdfNmspId}
